decisionText: Approve the first M4 increment, SPEC-020, against the frozen candidate 4dd52c8, and adopt ADR 0019 with the documented scope and limits.
originalStatement: Apruebo el primer corte de M4, SPEC-020, sobre el candidato congelado 4dd52c8, y adopto ADR 0019 con el alcance y los límites documentados
scope: Bounded owned local Git runtime: 2–4 ordinary-text patches, serial authorized private execution, effect/result verification and process-interruption recovery.
acceptedLimits: Darwin arm64 reproduction; Linux host reproduction pending.
No hard child-memory cap; sampled scratch can overshoot.
Hostile same-UID interference and power-loss guarantees excluded.
No arbitrary code, external effects or source-ref promotion.
perRunAuthorization: Separate matching manifest acknowledgement remains required.
